sections.title: The Rules of the Hub
sections.body: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the Kenya AI Compute platform, including our cloud console, API, and physical colocation services. We believe that professional infrastructure requires professional legal clarity. Our terms outline the responsibilities of both parties: our commitment to providing 99.9% uptime and industrial-grade security, and your commitment to using our resources for lawful and ethical purposes. We explicitly prohibit the use of our compute power for malicious activities, but we also ensure that your right to privacy and ownership of your 'compute results' is absolute. These terms are subject to the laws of Kenya, with provisions for international arbitration, providing a secure legal foundation for our global client base. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
